name: OrbusNeich Medical Group Holdings Limited
summary: OrbusNeich Medical Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture, trading, sale, and marketing of medical devices/instruments for the treatment of coronary and peripheral vascular diseases. The company offers semi-compliant balloons and scoring balloons for pre-dilatation and lesion preparation, drug-coated balloons and stents for lesion therapy, non-compliant balloons for post-dilatation, and specialty catheters, as well as microcatheters, guide catheter extension, dual therapy, and drug eluting stents.
